mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below its 12-month moving average compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in < 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.0% over the past 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in < 40% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous acceleration in inflation (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% year-over-year) and a tightening in monetary policy (FEDFUNDS rising > 0.5% in 3 months) indicates an aggressive monetary policy response to inflation, which compresses equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL > 5.0% and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 50% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (GDPC1 growth above 2.5% and UNRATE below 3.5%), the S&P 500 is prone to mean-reversion, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy approaches a peak.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in < 40% of instances when in late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100.0 signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings growth and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in < 40% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales above its 3-month moving average signals strong consumer spending, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in < 60% of instances when RSAFS is above its 3-month moving average, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI inflation rate above 5.0% signals persistent inflationary pressures, which prompt the Fed to maintain a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in < 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 5.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in employment growth (PAYEMS growth below 0.2% monthly) and rising unemployment (UNRATE increasing by more than 0.2% in 3 months) signals a deteriorating labor market, which reduces consumer spending and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth < 0.2% and UNRATE rises > 0.2% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in < 50% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
